content.text: ▪︎dyslipidemia = abnormality in any serum lipid level
- meds: thiazides, BBs, retinoids, antiretrovirals, cyclosporine,
HTN, DM, FHx of premature ASCVD, cigarette smoke, CKD, obesity
– inflam disorders (ex, RA, SLE, psoriasis, HIV)
•yellow collection of cholest under skin, USU on/peri eyelids
•MC medial eyelids; classic feature of PBC
•lipemia retinalis: cream-colored blood vessels in fundus
screen traditional RFs & obtain baseline fasting lipid profile for ≥20y,
if 1+ traditional RF (HTN, obesity, diabetes, etc.)
f/u lipid screening @ 25-30yo for males, 30-35yo for females
start regular lipid screening @ 35yo for males, 45yo for female
▪︎USPSTF: statin for primary prevention in adults 40-75yo w/ ≥1 CV RF + est 10-yr CVD risk ≥10% (RFs: age, cholesterol, obesity, SBP, DM, smoking)
▪︎statin SEs: nausea, constipation, ⇡AST/ALT (hepatotoxicity), hepatitis, cirrhosis, pancreatitis, cholelithiasis, ⇡CK, rhabdomyolysis, SJS, thrombocytopenia
▪︎high-intensity (⇣LDL ≥50%): atorvastatin 40-80mg, rosuvastatin 20-40mg; moderate-intensity (⇣LDL 30-50%): atorvastatin 10-20mg, rosuvastatin 5-10mg, simvastatin 20-40mg, pravastatin 40-80mg
3) anyone w ASCVD (MI, stable/unstable angina, CVA, PAD, etc.)
2026 ACC/AHA (PREVENT-ASCVD), adults 30-79 w/ LDL 70-189 w/o DM:
– 10-yr risk <3% (low): moderate-intensity if LDL 160-189 or 30-yr risk ≥10%
– 3-<5% (borderline): moderate-intensity (± coronary artery calcium to decide)
– 40-75yo + DM: moderate-intensity; DM + multiple ASCVD RFs → high-intensity
– >75yo + DM + life expectancy ≥2.5y: moderate-intensity after risk/benefit discussion
– 20-39yo + long-duration DM, albuminuria, eGFR <60, retinopathy, neuropathy, or ABI <0.9: moderate-intensity
– consider statin in select pts: CKD stage 3+, HIV
repeat lipid profile 4-12wks after statin initiation/dosage chg
